name: 已验证证据卡的有界跨来源综合上下文
purpose: Build a deterministic, budgeted synthesis packet from adopted angles and verified evidence cards only.
eligibility_checks: at least one angle is adopted
at least one verified card fits the declared budget
assumptions: the adoption ledger and evidence-card hashes are current for the same run
human_gates: review the final interpretation and preserve card caveats
diagnostics: used and omitted card counts, character budget, and omission reasons
allowed_claims: which verified cards were admitted or omitted by budget
forbidden_claims: an angle packet answers the core question
a synthesis packet independently proves a causal or population claim
